summary.headline: Nourishment and Length of Life
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging length of life and nourishment in a nativity: the Moon besieged by malefics indicates short life, while triplicity lords, the part of fortune, reception, planetary aspects, sect, and oriental or occidental position determine nourishment and support from kin and friends.
